Package com.miniandmore.app.service.criteria

Class OrderItemCriteria

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.criteria.OrderItemCriteria
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, tech.jhipster.service.Criteria
public class OrderItemCriteria extends Object implements Serializable, tech.jhipster.service.Criteria
Criteria class for the OrderItem entity. This class is used in
invalid reference 
com.miniandmore.app.web.rest.OrderItemResource
to receive all the possible filtering options from the Http GET request parameters. For example the following could be a valid request: /order-items?id.greaterThan=5&attr1.contains=something&attr2.specified=false As Spring is unable to properly convert the types, unless specific Filter class are used, we need to use fix type specific filters.
